fields.name: PgParameterMapAttribute construction and SQL type name
fields.contract: A derived PgParameterMapAttribute is initialized with a parameter name and an NpgsqlDbType, with an overload that also accepts whether the mapping is required. PgParameterMapAttribute exposes SqlTypeName as the textual name of the selected NpgsqlDbType. Each derived PgParameterMapAttribute supplies its own ColumnDefinition string.
